rules: Projection code resolves canonical source paths only from this registry; request parameters never become filesystem paths.
A source absent from this registry is not projected by P2.
Non-materialized frozen candidates remain governed references but are not silently substituted with older semantic versions.
Adding another Daughter requires only a registry entry when it conforms to a supported canonical profile; renderer/domain-specific projection logic is prohibited.

A precompiled PUBLIC_SAFE projection may materialize a frozen candidate for the public Daughter renderer when the exact canonical source is retained in the governed source vault and its SHA-256 is pinned; this does not materialize a governance-canonical projection or manufacture missing semantic depth.
Operational Knowledge v1 sources must report Information Resolution v2 depth as not populated rather than infer or fabricate it.
